title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.111
exact_target: Classify the finite simple groups, apart from Suzuki groups, admitting the source’s pairwise 3-divisibility-avoiding automorphisms, and ask whether any such automorphism has odd order.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2620 (KOU-21.111). CC BY 4.0.

D. O. Revin and N. Y. Yang, Problem 21.111, in E. I. Khukhro and V. D. Mazurov (eds.), \emph{The Kourovka Notebook: Unsolved Problems in Group Theory}, 21st edition, arXiv:1401.0300v48 (6 October 2026).
